description: This 3D model preview shows a wooden staircase with black balusters and a light-colored wooden handrail. The treads of the stairs appear to be a bright yellow color, contrasting with the natural wood of the stringers and newel posts. The staircase is positioned against a wall painted in a light, muted green hue. Shadows are cast on the wall, suggesting a light source from the side. The floor in front of the stairs is tiled with a pattern of light gray and white squares. A newel post at the bottom of the stairs features a simple, classical design. The overall impression is of a functional and clean-looking staircase, likely found in a residential setting.
